body.content:
i) China - Power Outages & impact this may have in the short term
  • Problem began in September || roughly 20% impact to capacity output 
  • Aomei factory deemed High power user and given subsequent power restrictions
  • 70% of RH production is done in Aomei | 30% outsourced
  • Factory implementing power generators which can run entire factory except for the powder coating line
  • Not allowed to run P.Coat line || aim to run P.Coat on night shift || factory looking for another generator to add additional power to run powder coating line
  • Government trying to lift some of restrictions through coal purchases from Russia and Indonesia
  • Different factory has different closure periods, mostly limited to southern China
  • Aomei needs to check with local council members if Aomei can get additional allowable power days
  • Usually only have off 1 sunday of a month
  • RH have secured addition space Yantian to west coast 18 days with new carriers (CML & Mersck) carrier
  • Shipping action to address backlog:
    • Doris Xu to put together weekly forecast #of units to assist the forwarders & transit services with faster shipping to US 
    • forward looking container count split into West Coast and East Coast, split up by week
    • AY (RH) will then arrange call with AAP

  • What are the next available teak ship dates || HtC has sent ship windows to Katie || MA have no open capacity till March 
  • Current Capacity 30-35 due to wood limitations || should be more like 40-45 due log shortages
  • Cutting season Feb-March | MA asking 6000m Cubic | Perhitani only approved 3000m Cubic as log demand is very large across Java
  • Wood sourced from other areas will still be certified wood that meets regulatory requirements
